layers.title: Monthly precipitation total
layers.valueInterpretation: Float32 estimated accumulated precipitation for the selected calendar month, not a daily rainfall rate, forecast, anomaly or satellite scene. Values are already millimetres (scale 1, offset 0). The publisher declares -9999 as a bad/missing value; this product declaration is distinct from an embedded TIFF NoData tag.

warnings: The whole quasi-global monthly file (180°W–180°E, 60°S–60°N) is downloaded; the selected map area does not crop it. Estimates are over land and ocean/missing pixels must be masked.

OpenTopography documents the January 2021 V3.2/3.1 average archive. It does not expose all original JAXA quality/mask/stack files and is not the newest JAXA product release. High-latitude longitude pixel spacing may differ; use embedded georeferencing.

The verified low-latitude COG is PixelIsArea, 3,600 × 3,600 Int16 samples, with no embedded TIFF NoData tag. Missing-data interpretation requires the product manual/quality masks; zero must not automatically be discarded.

JAXA requires source credits and credits for named third-party data. Commercial use is free of charge under its research-data terms but requires notifying JAXA in advance; retaining these terms is separate from connecting or testing a public file.

layers.title: D8 drainage direction
layers.valueInterpretation: UInt8 categorical drainage directions: 1 east, 2 southeast, 4 south, 8 southwest, 16 west, 32 northwest, 64 north, 128 northeast; 0 sink (no direction), 255 NoData. These are routing codes, not elevation, water depth, flow accumulation, river vectors or observed water motion.

warnings: The complete published tile is downloaded, not clipped to the requested area. Ocean tiles may be absent or contain only NoData.

Only the 100 DIR tiles in the publisher's 20260830 v2r0 index are supported; current published coverage is the Americas, not global. Any requested tile outside that finite list fails explicitly. This connector does not substitute v1, ACC/ACA, river vectors or a different release.

Some published DIR tiles exceed the current 512 MiB original transfer limit (the publisher lists files up to about 627 MB). Connecting or resolving a filename does not imply that the full original is downloadable within the runtime limit.
The original D8 codes are inspected as numerical samples. A raw grayscale thumbnail is not a scientific drainage visualization or a computed watershed.
